questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Sudan?

hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Sudan article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Khartoum.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Sudan?

hints.nudge: It is 3 words long and starts with the letter C.

questions.proof: Sudan borders Egypt to the north, Eritrea and Ethiopia to the east, South Sudan to the south, the Central African Republic to the southwest, Chad to the west, and Libya to the northwest.
